procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: USA 222917 was sailing upwind on leg 1 close-hauled on starboard tack.
AUS 204568 was sailing close-hauled on port tack.
The boats were on a collision course.
When USA 222917 was ½ boat length away from AUS 204568, with her bow aiming at the cockpit of AUS 204558, USA 222917 bore away.
conclusions: USA 222917 had a reasonable apprehension of collision.
AUS 204568, a port-tack boat, failed to keep clear of USA 222917, and broke rule 10.
decision: AUS 204568 is to be scored DSQ in race 9
